## Summary

I diagnosed the class and produced a verified, self-contained solution at:

**`~/board-header-two-phase-invariant-fix.md`**

### Root cause
The DF-H3-24 invariant requires `board.jsonl` header `last_commit` to be **at most one behind `HEAD`**. Because a commit can't contain its own SHA, the header correctly records its parent (`HEAD~1`). The commit-time hook only re-pins when board files are staged, so a non-board commit (evidence/manifest/docs) on top of an already-one-behind header pushes it to `HEAD~2` → `make verify` fails on every fresh clone. The re-pin is a property of *advancing HEAD*, not of *staging board files* — that's the defect.

### Exact fix
1. **Unconditional auto-repin in the commit hook** — replace the `if git diff --cached --name-only | grep '^\.coding-hermes/board/'` guard with a plain `make board-close` (a ready-to-drop pre-commit hook is included).
2. **`make board-close`** — idempotently pins `last_commit` to `git rev-parse HEAD` and stages `board.jsonl`.
3. **`make verify` → `verify-board-header`** — hard guard that recomputes `HEAD`/`HEAD~1`/`last_commit` and fails if two-or-more behind.
4. Recovery recipe for already-drifted repos, plus edge-case notes (amend/rebase/merge/`--no-verify`).

### Verification (actually executed)
Built a real `git` + `boardctl` reproduction:
- Buggy hook + board closeout + one evidence commit → `board-header: FAIL` (`last_commit` = `HEAD~2`).
- `make board-close` + header-alone commit → `ALL PASS`.
- Fixed hook + another evidence commit → the commit automatically carried `board.jsonl`, and `last_commit == HEAD~1` → `ALL PASS`.

I also ran the **exact Makefile snippet from the document**: forcing a 2-behind header produced `make: *** [verify-board-header] Error 1`; healing produced `ALL PASS`, confirming the deliverable is directly usable.

signatures.description: h3 umbrella (JSONL board with board.jsonl header): the DF-H3-24 two-phase invariant requires header last_commit at most ONE commit behind HEAD, but the commit-time hook auto-repins the header ONLY when board files are staged. Any non-board commit (evidence/manifest/docs) that advances HEAD without a manual make board-close therefore leaves the header TWO behind and every fresh clone fails the board-header guard of make verify. Recurring class (tick 562 closeout left it 4 behind; tick 564 evidence commit reproduced it and a GitReins judge failed the criterion at the evidence SHA). Recipe: before ANY commit that will advance HEAD when the header is already at HEAD~1, run make board-close first (it re-pins last_commit to the current HEAD = the coming commit parent), then commit; for a multi-commit closeout make the LAST carry the re-pin (board data commit then header-alone commit). Verify: make verify at the final SHA prints ALL PASS with the header VERDICT line showing last_commit equal to HEAD~1.
